label: Elkanah

text.KJV 1CH 6:34: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
text.KJV 1CH 6:35: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
text.KJV 1CH 6:36: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

A.name: Elkanah
A.line: father of Zophai [Zuph] (1CH 6:26) and son of Mahath (1CH 6:35)
family: father-of zuph (Zuph, father of Tohu and ancestor of Samuel (1SA 1:1))

B.name: Elkanah
B.line: father of Amasai and Ahimoth (1CH 6:25) and son of Joel (1CH 6:36)

why: The Hebrew chain in verse 35 makes Zuph the son of Elkanah and Elkanah the son of Mahath, matching A. B’s stated position as Amasai’s father and Joel’s son belongs to the Elkanah in verse 36.
